market_view: Risk appetite returned on July 30 (VIX -17% to 17.1, chips +6.9%), the Fed held rates and the 10-year yield sits near its 52-week high at 4.66%; oil keeps giving back its war premium (WTI -9.3% in 5 days) while copper rises on supply news.

oil_gas.catalyst: none qualifying: 'Exxon and Chevron profits surge on rising oil prices due to Iran war' (CNBC) is a reported quarter, and 'Chevron and Exxon earnings soar as Trump threatens price interventions' (Financial Times) is a downside policy risk
oil_gas.reasoning: Q2 profits are backward-looking and known; crude fell 9-12% in 5 days as Iran tensions eased, and Trump price-intervention threats cap upside. No fresh named supply-shock headline, so no XOM re-entry.

gold_miners.catalyst: none: NEM headlines are options chatter and analyst-opinion pieces
gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.6% and NEM +4.8% on a weaker dollar are already priced; yields remain near highs. No NEM-specific catalyst.

chips.catalyst: none: 'AMD and Micron surge, Lam Research climbs 17% as chip stocks rip higher' (CNBC) is a price move, not an NVDA catalyst
chips.reasoning: One-day sector rebound after a rout; volatility high, no NVDA-specific news. No rebound guessing.

pharma.catalyst: Continuing hold from 2026-07-23: retatrutide Phase 3 wins (July 23 record); no contrary LLY headline in today's record
pharma.reasoning: LLY -4.6% on July 30 came with JNJ -3.7% and the health care ETF -1.6%, a sector move with no LLY-specific bad news. Hold the open long to its planned end (around Aug 6); Q2 earnings add variance.

copper_uranium.catalyst: 'Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring' (CNBC, 2026-07-31): a named supply shock to copper; supply outages take weeks to resolve, so not fully priced after one day
copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +2.7% and FCX +5.8% already reacted, but a physical supply squeeze tends to persist; copper is 3% from its 52-week high and above its 200-day average. Tariff and demand risk keep confidence at the bar.

would_change_my_mind: A headline that the copper supply disruption is resolved, or LLY-specific bad news (trial, pricing, compounding, weak Q2 guidance), or a fresh named Hormuz supply-shock headline for oil.

handoff.what_changed: Exxon and Chevron reported surging Q2 profits but Trump threatened price interventions, and crude kept falling (WTI -9.3% in 5 days). A CNBC headline reports storms and a global supply squeeze sending copper soaring, so FCX is a new long. The Fed held rates; chips rebounded sharply for one day; LLY fell 4.6% in a sector-wide pharma drop.

oil_gas.why: Earnings are backward-looking, price-intervention threat, no new supply-shock headline.

gold_miners.why: No NEM catalyst; yields near highs.

pharma.why: Retatrutide Phase 3 wins; July 30 drop was sector-wide with no LLY news.

copper_uranium.why: CNBC: storms and a global supply squeeze sending copper prices soaring (named supply shock).

open_storylines.note: Trump ire at Exxon/Chevron profits and threatened price interventions; a downside policy risk for oil names.

open_storylines.note: Global tariffs drawing rebukes; inflation risk; watch copper demand and pharma tariff policy.

open_storylines.note: Sharp July 30 rebound after the rout; Big Tech capex and NVDA news are the signals. No rebound guessing.

open_storylines.note: Retatrutide wins; LLY Q2 earnings early August; watch pricing, compounding and the sector drop of July 30.

open_storylines.note: Storms and global supply squeeze; watch for resolution of outages or a demand/tariff hit. FCX long ends around 2026-08-14.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day, check the LLY long (opened 2026-07-23, ends around 2026-08-06) for Q2 earnings, pricing or compounding news; check the FCX long (opened 2026-07-31) for news that the copper supply squeeze is easing or tariff/demand shocks; check oil for a renewed supply-shock headline before any XOM re-entry; then read the new record for a named catalyst in each family.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: oil longs opened on a named supply-shock escalation headline (sanctions, ship attacks, attacks deepening disruption) win over 10 days.
lessons.evidence: XOM 2026-07-07 net +6.82% (basket +8.64%); XOM 2026-07-10 net +12.76% (basket +10.51%); XOM 2026-07-15 net +8.22% (basket +6.06%). All in one Iran episode; below 5 cases, does not change calls.
